tools.name: inspect_website
tools.description: Fetch a public business website page and return structured, accessible facts for a buyer-readiness review. It only examines the supplied public URL and does not scrape review platforms or private systems.

tools.name: score_website_evaluability
tools.description: Inspect a public business website and score how easily a buyer can identify the business, understand a target service, verify proof, and take the next step. Returns an explainable 0–100 rubric and priorities.

tools.name: organize_review_evidence
tools.description: Organize user-supplied public review excerpts into transparent positive, risk, owner-response, and corrective-action signals. The tool does not fetch reviews itself and does not adjudicate any claim.

tools.name: compare_shortlist_candidates
tools.description: Compare two to six businesses after the user has gathered website and review scores. Calculates a transparent shortlist score using 60% review trust and 40% website evaluability.

tools.name: generate_paid_scope
tools.description: Turn a ShortlistLens result into a concise fixed-scope implementation brief for a Buyer-Readiness Scorecard or a 72-hour AI Buyer-Readiness Sprint.
